the security of the CTR mode with the «CryptoPro Re-keying Method» ( CPM ) is the same as that of the Magma cipher, and the security of CTR mode with CPM is the same as the security of the Magma CTR encryption mode, and that the security of CPM is the best possible in the sense that it cannot be improved without sacrificing the operational features of CPM.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the CTR mode of the Kuzanyechik and Magma ciphers with a re-keying method is secure if the method is based on the use of a strong pseudorandom permutation.
the re-keying method should be developed for a particular cipher, and it should not be used with different ciphers.
